title: KPEX: Korean Pop Culture Expo to Launch in New York City in 2027
content: LeftField Media announced on Thursday the launch of KPEX: Korean Pop Culture Expo, a new three-day convention celebrating Korean entertainment and culture in New York City. content: A television anime adaptation of Sekina Aoi and Ryou Tsuzura 's Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito ( My Crush's Crush ) manga was announced on Friday. Tsuzura drew an illustration to commemorate the announcement (pictured above).

title: My Crush's Crush Manga Gets TV Anime
content: Writer Sekina Aoi and artist Ryō Tsuzura 's My Crush’s Crush ( Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito ) manga is getting a television anime adaptation. Tsuzura shared an illustration to commemorate the announcement: When Sora Akizuki confesses his feelings to Miya Fuwa, he gets rejected outright.

title: Whisper of the Heart UK Cinema Release Details Confirmed
content: In a press release on Thursday, GKIDS has confirmed UK cinema release details for Studio Ghibli 's 1995 film Whisper of the Heart , directed by Yoshifumi Kondō , in mid-September. The 4K remastered film will appear on IMAX screens from Wednesday September 16, with a wider cinema release from Friday September 18.
author: ANN

title: Gamers! Creator Sekina Aoi's My Crush's Crush Manga Gets TV Anime
content: Sekina Aoi’s My Crush’s Crush (Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito) manga is officially getting a TV anime adaptation. An announcement illustration by manga artist Ryo Tsuzura was released along with the news. Sekina Aoi is also known as the creator of the Gamers! manga.

title: Maebashi Witches Compilation Film Streams Main Trailer
